UniProt natural variants and mutagenesis results are excluded: they come from disease variants and would leak ClinVar-like information into the features.
n_annotations (how many curated categories mark a residue) is also a feature; buried_sasa (surface buried by a partner, computed from PDB complexes) exists for two showcase genes only.
